theorems.name: Submission.intcpt_allard_cylinder_cluster_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (K : ℝ) (m : ℕ), 0 ≤ K → ∃ c δm : ℝ, 0 ≤ c ∧ 0 < δm ∧ ∀ δ ε : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ ≤ δm → 0 < ε → ε ≤ δ ^ 4 → ∀ (μ : Measure (Euclidean N)) (P : Grassmannian N n) (x : Euclidean N) (s : Finset (Euclidean N)), s.card ≤ m → (∀ y ∈ s, Grassmannian.project P y = x ∧ ‖y - Grassmannian.project P y‖ < ε ∧ MonotoneOn (fun r : ℝ ↦ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (ε * r)) * μ (closedBall y r) / ENNReal.ofReal r ^ n) (Ioo 0 1) ∧ ∀ τ σ ρ : ℝ, 0 < τ → τ ≤ 1 → 0 < σ → σ ≤ ρ → ρ < 1 → μ (closedBall y σ ∩ {z | ‖(z - y) - Grassmannian.project P (z - y)‖ < τ}) / ENNReal.ofReal σ ^ n ≤ μ (closedBall y ρ ∩ {z | ‖(z - y) - Grassmannian.project P (z - y)‖ < 2 * τ}) / ENNReal.ofReal ρ ^ n + ENNReal.ofReal (K * ε * ρ / τ)) → ∀ σ τ : ℝ, 0 < σ → σ ≤ δ ^ 2 → 2 * δ ^ 2 * σ ≤ τ → (∀ y ∈ s, ∀ y' ∈ s, y ≠ y' → 4 * τ ≤ ‖y - y'‖) → ∑ y ∈ s, μ (closedBall y σ ∩ {z | ‖(z - y) - Grassmannian.project P (z - y)‖ < τ}) / ENNReal.ofReal σ ^ n ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (1 + c * δ ^ 2) * μ (closedBall x 1) + ENNReal.ofReal (c * δ ^ 2)
